title: solanum umbelliferum var. montanum
intro: Solanum umbelliferum var. montanum, commonly known as Mountain Honeysuckle or White Stems Honeysuckle, is a plant species in the Solanaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Solanum umbelliferum var. montanum include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
